description: This file defines a Java interface 'OcsAPI' for interacting with the Nextcloud Deck REST API, providing methods to fetch capabilities and user information via HTTP GET requests.

classes.name: OcsAPI
classes.description: A Java interface for accessing Nextcloud's Deck API endpoints, including fetching capabilities and user details.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of the Nextcloud Deck API, with support for ETag caching.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches user information based on user ID.
